transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess they brought me in because of what’s been happening at the warehouse. I keep doing things I know look weird… like freezing with my arms up near the forklift, copying the beeping sounds and the hand signals, or moving boxes into little patterns even when people are yelling at me to stop.
Have you noticed yourself doing things like freezing in place or repeating sounds and movements for as long as you can remember, or is this something that started more recently?
No, not as long as I can remember. It’s more recent. The weird stuff at the warehouse, and the way I talk getting confusing sometimes… that’s been going on for about six months.
Have you been experiencing anything like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't seem to notice, or having thoughts or beliefs that others have told you don't make sense?
I don’t know… not really. I mean, people say what I’m doing doesn’t make sense, but I’m not sure about voices or seeing things. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Have you had any recent medical illnesses, head injuries, neurological problems, or new substance or medication use around the time these episodes started six months ago?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember anything big happening around then. I don’t know about medical stuff or anything like that.
Over the past six months, have you noticed times when you feel unusually confused, drowsy, or like your alertness comes and goes, especially around the episodes at work?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed being drowsy or my alertness coming and going like that. At work I know things get confusing sometimes, but I can’t really say if it’s that kind of confused.
When you say your talking gets confusing, can you describe what happens—do you lose track of what you're trying to say, or do others tell you your sentences don't connect logically?

Yeah… I think it’s more that people say it doesn’t connect. Like my supervisor will ask which pallets are supposed to go on the truck, and I start trying to explain it from the load sheet, but then I’ll end up talking about my old house, or fishing, or church boxes. I don’t mean to, it just kind of jumps around. Then by the time I’m done, nobody knows what I was trying to say.
Have you noticed any other physical changes recently, like unexplained fevers, weight loss, tremors, or loss of bladder control, around the same time these episodes started?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed fevers or anything like that. My weight seems about the same, and I don’t think I’ve had tremors or bladder problems. Nothing physical really stands out to me.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any neurological condition, such as epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a brain injury, at any point in your life?
No, not that I know of. I haven’t been told I have seizures or epilepsy or anything like that. I don’t think I’ve had a brain injury diagnosed either.
Over these past six months, have you noticed yourself pulling away from friends or family, losing interest in things you used to enjoy, or feeling less emotion than before?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I haven’t been keeping track of that exactly. I guess I still talk to my family some, but I don’t know if I’ve been pulling away. I haven’t really noticed feeling less emotion, not in a clear way.

Have you had any beliefs or thoughts recently that other people have told you seem unusual, untrue, or hard to believe—for example, thinking someone was watching you, controlling you, or trying to harm you?
I don’t know. I mean, people haven’t really told me that directly. I haven’t been sure what to think sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call it that.
Has anyone in your family—like a parent, sibling, or close relative—ever been diagnosed with schizophrenia or another serious mental illness?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know of anyone in my family being diagnosed with something like that. If there is, nobody’s told me.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory, or times when you felt confused about where you were, what day it was, or who people were around you?

I haven’t really noticed that. My memory seems okay, I think. I don’t remember being confused about where I was or who people were. Maybe I lose track of the day sometimes, but not in a way that felt serious.

No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed joint pain or rashes or anything like that. I get tired sometimes, but nothing unusual that I know of. And I haven’t been told I have thyroid problems or an autoimmune disease.
Not really, no. I don’t have anything like that that I know of. I mean, I haven’t been diagnosed with any medical problems, and I haven’t noticed those kinds of symptoms.
